items.text: The machine chooser has a model for showing how busy each machine is.
A pane id no pane carries any more is refused after a restart instead of answering to whatever came back in its place.
A machine reached through your account is named the same in its Activity panel whichever way you open it.
The agent's --relay daemon mode now has on-box proof that it parks and resumes around a pending revocation.
A dropped remote link is now checked against the tabs beside its pill, not just the pill.
